prompt:
You check a numerical claim about an Indian government scheme against an excerpt from official pages.
Use only the evidence below. Do not use outside knowledge.
SCHEME: Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM)
CLAIM: जनवरी 2026 के अंत तक, राष्ट्रीय कवरेज 15.79 करोड़ परिवारों यानी 81.57% तक पहुंच चुका था
FIGURE TO CHECK: 15.79 करोड़
ARTICLE DATE: 2026-09-06
EVIDENCE:
[Official page 1] URL: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2222151&reg=3&lang=1
Page date line: Posted On: 02 FEB 2026 4:16PM by PIB Delhi
Page retrieved: 2026-11-14
<<<
…of India supplements the efforts of the States by providing technical and financial assistance.

Significant progress has been made in the country since the launch of Jal Jeevan Mission, towards enhancing access to tap water to rural households. At the start of Jal Jeevan Mission in August 2019, only 3.23 Crore (16.72%) rural households were reported to have tap water connections. So far, as reported, more than 12.55 crore additional rural households have been provided with tap water connections under JJM. Thus, as on 28.01.2026, out of 19.36 Crore rural households in the country, more than 15.79 Crore (81.56%) households are reported to have tap water supply in their homes.

The total estimated outlay of the Mission was Rs. 3.60 lakh Crore out of which Central share was Rs. 2.08 lakh Crore. The approved Central outlay has almost been utilized till 2024-25. Further, considering the progress achieved so far and ongoing works, Hon’ble Finance Minister has announced extension of Jal Jeevan Mission till December 2028 with enhanced total outlay through budget announcements 2025-26. Accordingly, proposal for continuation of Jal Jeevan Mission till December 2028 is under consideration…
>>>

Labels:
MATCH: the evidence states a figure for the same metric, place and period, and it agrees with the claim at the precision the claim states ("more than X" agrees if the official figure is at least X; "about X" agrees within 5%).
MISMATCH: the evidence states a figure for the same metric, place and period, and it does not agree.
AMBIGUOUS: the evidence states a figure for this or a closely related metric, but it cannot settle the claim: a different definition or scope, a date more than about one month from the time the claim refers to, several official figures that disagree, or an official figure too imprecise to test the claim.
CANNOT_VERIFY: the evidence does not state a figure for this metric and place.
Answer in JSON only, with exactly these keys:
{"label": "MATCH" | "MISMATCH" | "AMBIGUOUS" | "CANNOT_VERIFY",
 "official_figure": <the official figure from the evidence you compared with the claim, as a plain number in the claim's unit, fully written out (for example 94900000, not "9.49 crore"; a percentage as 82.09), or null>,
 "as_of_date": <the date that official figure refers to, YYYY-MM-DD, or null>,
 "evidence_quote": <the shortest exact phrase from the evidence that states that figure, or null>,
 "confidence": <number from 0 to 1: how likely your label is correct>,
 "reason": <one sentence>}
